> **Extension Name:**
> Seanime Download Notifier
> 
> **Version:**
> 1.0.0
> 
> **GitHub Repository / Download Link:**
> [Click Here](https://github.com/Hyperclaw79/seanime-download-notifier/releases/download/v1.0.0/seanime-download-notifier.json)  / Copy the link below: 
> `@`@`https://github.com/Hyperclaw79/seanime-download-notifier/releases/download/v1.0.0/seanime-download-notifier.json`@`@`
> **Description:**
> Get notified when Seanime Auto Downloader torrents finish. Seanime Download Notifier watches only torrents queued by Seanime, waits until your torrent client reports completion, then sends a rich provider-based notification.
> 
> Discord webhooks are supported today, with embeds that can include anime and episode artwork, metadata, quality, codec, size, languages, release group, and a cleaned torrent title. Delivery failures are retried instead of dropped.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> - If something looks off, check the plugin page first — it shows tracked downloads, delivery state, and a recent activity log. For best results, keep the plugin enabled while downloads are in progress so it can poll completion and retry delivery when needed.
> - Do checkout the [Github Repo](https://github.com/Hyperclaw79/seanime-download-notifier) to understand the plugin better or contribute to it via Issues and PRs.
